command: source "$HOME/build-workers/worker-env.sh"; cargo test -p ifc-lite-geometry --lib --no-fail-fast; geometry_status=$?; cargo test -p ifc-lite-processing --lib --test positional_read_ratchet --no-fail-fast; processing_status=$?; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; clippy_status=$?; printf "geometry_exit=%s processing_exit=%s clippy_exit=%s\n" "$geometry_status" "$processing_status" "$clippy_status"; if [ "$geometry_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$geometry_status"; fi; if [ "$processing_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$processing_status"; fi; exit "$clippy_status"
